MOEKETSI MAJORO MALEBANA LE BOEMO BA KOKOANA-HLOKO EA COVID19 KA HARE HO NAHA EA LESOTHO LE HO FIHLA HOA ENTE

[Litumeliso] Sechaba ba heso, ke hlaha ho lona mantsibueng a kajeno ho tla le qhatsetsa lintho tse peli, e leng boemo ba litšoaetso tsa kokoana-hloko ea Corona le kentelo ea teng, ekasita le mokhoa o mocha oa lihlahlobo malibohong
Boemo ba Litšoaetso le Kentelo ea Covid-19 Basotho ba heso, boemo ba litšoaetso tsa kokoana-hloko ea Covid-19 naheng ea rona bo nyolohile haholo matsatsing ana
Litšoaetso li nyolohetse ho 2,654 ho tloha ho 48 libekeng tse ‘ne tse fetileng
Ha re e sheba ka mokhoa o mong, sekhahla sa litšoaetso se nyolohetse ho 9% ho tloha ho 0
9%, e leng hore litšoaetso li imenahantse ha leshome ho tloha mafelong a khoeli a Pulungoana
Sekhahla sa bakuli ba kenang le ho sebelisa libethe litsing tsa bophelo ha sea fetoha hakalo (5% to 6%)

Maoba mona ha ke utloa ‘metso, le matšoao a sefuba ke ile ka etsa lihlahlobo, ‘me maobane tsa khutla li supa boteng ba kokoana hloko ena
Ntle le matšoao ana a fokolang ke ikutloa ke ntse ke phetse hantle, ‘me re leboha Morena Molimo ke hona
Puisanong le Woman Police Constable (W/P/C) 'Malillo Ntsetselane ho tsoa Motebong oa Sepolesa Marakabei, o re ka khoeli ea Phato 2025, ho…
Bo ‘Me le bo Ntate, Ntumelleng ke phethele polelo ena ea ‘Muso ka ho leboha ka tsela e khethehileng lona bohle ba kentseng letsoho lipuisanong tsena tse bileng mofuthu
Moea ona oa Khotso o neng o rena ka mona, ha e ke be lelomolo ho rona ho ea pele, re tle re atameleng litaba tsena ka lerato leo re tsejoang ka lona re le bana ba motho
Ha re eeng ho Basotho metseng le metsaneng ea bona, ho ea nka maikutlo a bona e le tlatsetso ha re ntse re bopa sesiu sa maikutlo
Re le ‘Muso re tla tséhetsa mehato eohle ea ho bona hore sena se ea etsahala, ‘me ka bolokolohi bo lokelehang ho Mosotho e mong le e mong
Ka polelo ena e khuts’oanyane, re le ‘Muso oa Lesotho re tiisa boitlamo ba rona ba ho phethahatsa ho kengoa tsebetsong hoa morero oa Tlhopho bocha ea Naha re sa thekesele
Lesotho le Lecha ke bokamoso baka, bokamoso ba Hau, bokamoso ba bana ba rona, ‘me ke moo teng lerato, khotso, botsitso, kholo ea moruo, le ho ts’aba Morena Molimo, e tlang ho ba lelomolo
